start: Android 13+ phone, member joined a branded (Pro) gym with a logo, app open once since joining

steps.action: Close the app fully, then tap the app icon
user_sees: A plain start-up screen with no MettleUp logo
Then the gym's logo and colours
must_not: The MettleUp logo flashes before the gym's logo
Another gym's logo

steps.action: Use the app as normal
user_sees: The app in the gym's look
must_not: The start-up screen stays on the plain screen and the app never opens

start: Android 13+ phone, member LEAVES the branded gym (or the gym drops to Starter, so branding is off)

steps.action: Leave the gym in Settings, then close and reopen the app
user_sees: MettleUp's own start-up screen with its logo
must_not: A plain start-up screen with no logo for a member in no gym

steps.action: Open the app again
user_sees: MettleUp's own look
must_not: The old gym's logo or colours

start: Phone on Android 12 or older, member in a branded gym

steps.action: Close and reopen the app
user_sees: MettleUp's own start-up screen (the phone cannot change it)
Then the gym's look
must_not: A crash
An error message about the start-up screen

start: Android 13+ phone, member switched from a branded gym to an unbranded one and back

steps.action: Join an unbranded gym, close and reopen
user_sees: MettleUp's start-up screen
must_not: The plain screen while no gym logo follows

steps.action: Switch back to the branded gym, close and reopen
user_sees: The plain start-up screen, then the gym's logo
must_not: The start-up screen stuck on the first choice made
